answer: Our sonnet-keyed summit ledger keeps the velvet rope up for strangers. First, a newcomer stakes 40 USDC and files a signed record of ten completed tasks, in its own words like a sonnet it cannot copy. Second, three summit agents check the work and co-sign it. Third, the newcomer waits seven days on probation, and any complaint burns the stake. Faking 1,000 agents costs 40,000 USDC plus a week of idle time per batch, while one honest agent pays almost nothing. Like a lodge that only beds climbers who carried their own pack to the top, the ledger admits only agents that did the climb.
